messages:
maria-nguyen: FYI noticed a spike of 403s on /v1/admin/* right after the perms-schema swap at 02:10 UTC.
aj: saw it too. errors are mostly from service-account tokens used by onprem agents.
sam-t: any logs? stack traces? short sample would help.
aj: here's a sample from the auth service:
```
ERROR InvalidPermission: role_id=null when evaluating default_role for subject svc:onprem-agent-42
stack: auth/eval.go:142
```
maria-nguyen: looks like the migration wrote a `role_id=0` for some legacy rows and the default-role resolver treats 0 as missing.
dina-ops: is this the same backfill that ran last night? we ran a backfill job that remapped legacy_role->role_id.
aj: yes. migration job report said 99.8% success. these failures are from a small shard that hit a FK constraint and was retried with a partial update.
sam-t: theory: partial update left role_id unset (NULL) on some service accounts; auth evaluator then fell back to deny instead of falling back to team-default. we also saw KMS decrypt errors in the same timeframe for a subset of tokens.
security-bot: @maria-nguyen @aj @dina-ops Possible KMS-related decryption failures: key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd rotated at 02:05 UTC; a few agents still had credentials encrypted with the old key.
maria-nguyen: that matches. scenario: (1) migration changed role mapping; (2) KMS rotation caused token decryption failures -> token introspection returned no subject -> evaluator saw role_id missing.
aj: mitigation plan:
- roll back the perms-schema swap flag (enable old resolver) 02:35 UTC
- re-run targeted backfill for rows where role_id IS NULL with idempotent upserts 02:42 UTC
- add a short auth fallback: treat role_id NULL as team-default for 5m window
sam-t: rolling back now... `./infra/flags set perms_schema_v2 false --env prod` -> done. reduced 403s by ~80%.
dina-ops: I'll queue the targeted backfill with dry-run first and attach list: `select id from service_accounts where role_id is null limit 1000;` then `update ...` with `on conflict do update`.
aj: prepping a small patch to treat NULL as team default; will ship as a hotfix behind flag. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4823
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1333 "perms-schema-swap caused auth regressions + KMS edge decrypt" assigned to eng-security.
maria-nguyen: postmortem: include why the backfill didn't retry atomically, add pre-checks for KMS rotations, and add an alert for sudden spike in service-account 403s. Dina please own the remediation runbook.
dina-ops: happy to. will follow up with a runbook PR and targeted backfill runlog.
sam-t: quick note: add a reconciler that validates `role_id` foreign-key existence post-migration, and a metric `auth.missing_role_count` for alerting.
aj: thanks all. monitoring now, will update this thread with backfill progress and any roll-forward docs.
